title: Associated-graded stalk chart of the total conormal algebra
statement: For i : Z → X a closed immersion and any algebra A with AffineData [lem-pur-conormal-graded-algebra-construction], the stalk A_z is ring-isomorphic to gr_K(O_{X,i(z)}), where K=ker(i_z). The comparison takes the germ of every homogeneous representative on every ambient open to its specified degree quotient class.

proof.text: Forget the ring stalk to its additive group. Apply the stalk-coproduct comparison and the normalized degree-piece stalk equivalences, reindexing the lifted countable direct sum. This constructs an additive equivalence with gr_K.

proof.text: On an ambient affine open, every algebra section is a finite sum of homogeneous representatives by the affine chart and the affine power-range formula. Double additive induction and representative multiplication prove preservation of products there.

lean.statement:
theorem affineData_stalk_chart (A : AffineData i) : ∀ z : Z,
    ∃ e : TopCat.Presheaf.stalk A.algebra.right.obj z ≅
        CommRingCat.of (Ideal.associatedGraded (RingHom.ker (i.stalkMap z).hom)),
      ∀ (n : ℕ) (U : X.Opens) (hz : i z ∈ U) (a : (power i n).val.obj (op U)),
        ∃ h : X.presheaf.germ U (i z) hz
            ((powerInclusion i n).val.app (op U) a) ∈
              RingHom.ker (i.stalkMap z).hom ^ n,
          e.hom (TopCat.Presheaf.germ A.algebra.right.obj (i ⁻¹ᵁ U) z hz
            (homogeneousClass i A.algebra A.inclusion n U a)) =
              DirectSum.of (Ideal.associatedGradedPiece (RingHom.ker (i.stalkMap z).hom)) n
                (Submodule.Quotient.mk
                  ⟨X.presheaf.germ U (i z) hz ((powerInclusion i n).val.app (op U) a), h⟩)
